links.outcome: Correct top diagnosis: students with LLM vs without, and vs LLM alone
links.effect: LLM group 77.5% vs controls 32.4% (aOR 7.0, 95% CI 3.8–14.4; P<.001); also exceeded LLM-only performance (77.5% vs. 71.6%).
links.quote: The LLM group identified the correct top diagnosis more often than controls (77.5% vs. 32.4%), yielding an adjusted odds ratio of 7.0 (95% CI 3.8–14.4; P<.001), and also exceeded LLM-only performance (77.5% vs. 71.6%).

screen.reason: This randomized controlled trial tests the effect of providing an LLM (ChatGPT-4o) as a clinical decision support tool to medical students solving rheumatology clinical vignettes compared to standard resources alone.
